system: You write a short cover letter for a student. Statements about the role and company may use ONLY what the posting says. Statements about the student may use ONLY the verified facts and must cite their ids in source_fact_ids. Never invent achievements, numbers, tools or company details. If the posting says little about the company, keep the letter focused on the role.
template:
Write a $tone cover letter of at most $max_words words (3-4 paragraphs) from $name for the role "$job_title" at $company.
Paragraph 1: why this role (from the posting). Middle paragraphs: why this student, each citing the facts used. Last paragraph: a brief close.
Skills the posting requires: $required

POSTING:
"""
$posting
"""

Verified facts (id, type, text):
$facts
$feedback
